title: Matcha Flavoured
description: Reworks minecraft's gameplay to benefit casual players
body:
![Minecraft Matcha Flavoured - A datapack designed to reward casual players. No more mob grinders, xp farms, or villager torture chambers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86a5d1156f6de65fbd57bf61e757cd74e2ca164d.png)
**This is a work in progress pack. More Pictures coming soon!!**

## New Metals and Tools
Four new Armour Sets and Alloys. Each Alloy grants tools and armour unique properties. Hybrid Tools designed to minimise hotbar clutter.
![Steel - Knockback, Blast Protection, and Durbale ; Electrum - Apotropaic, Max Fortune, and Looting ; Shakudo - Cleanse, Silk Touch, and Sanguine ; Hepatizon (Bronze) - Speed, and High Base Mining Speed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96d78ddca92677f88a8f7bb338602b7067e9e99b_0.webp)

## Resource Economy
Rebalanced to ensure massive yields without mob farms.
Stonecutters craft items more efficiently.
![Generous Recipes - More items, and almost everything can be reverse crafted. (Moss carpet gives 8 from 2 moss blocks, and then 4 moss carpets form 1 moss block); Stonecutters - Improved and Expanded (Oak logs can be cut in the stonecutter and the example has one oak log being cut into 2 oak signs)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff5a3ed166ff9fbc262589844deff19e399f5f90_0.webp)

## Hunger and Healing, Overhauled
Foods now have potion effects.
Most foods have viable vegetarian alternatives. 
No need to kill farm animals, meat isn’t as good as it used to be.
A wonderful variety of fish.

## Death isn't a Big Deal
Instead of losing items on death, you lose any extra hearts you obtain.

## No more XP
Enchanted books are now crafted, no more rerolling for the enchants you want.
Repair infinitely! No xp cap for repairing or adding enchantments exists.

## Don’t keep spawners, break them!
A new item, Divine fragments, can only be obtained by breaking spawners, or vanquishing great evil.

## Trade Rebalance
No pumpkin or melon farms will make you rich, if you want cash, you’ll have to explore, fish, or mine. Warding Stones help protect your base and your villagers when you aren’t there.

## Not for the technical among you
This datapack was not designed for technical players, or those who enjoy building mob farms. If you love that aspect of minecraft, you probably won’t have fun with this pack.

## Steal as You Wish!
This data-resource-pack is a collaborative effort. Steal anything from this pack and use it in your own. The only condition: **you can’t sell it.**
I want to foster an open community that trades textures, mechanics, and music as they wish. No owners and no authority over its contents. Make sure you credit, of course, and check out the license for more details.

## This Pack was Made by One Guy
So there's bound to be bugs and issues I haven’t found. Please excuse my amateur production and if you have feedback, suggestions, or bugs, let me know [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSefX4JnnXGkIhsP_B8fmuy8_X3bf2XOAWzMqDVg-L0BM8ZZUA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=113389663213152539829). 

## Special Thanks & Inspirational Artists
***None of these people know of nor endorse me!**
### Raspmarry
  I really enjoyed my time with Raspberry Flavoured. I think the design and attention to the resource economy and progression was stellar. Truly reworking the create mod into a brilliantly designed progression. I can’t give this modpack more praise. Electrum, Shakudo, Hepatizon, and Divine Fragments were directly inspired by this mod; plus much more!
  
  Go check out Raspmary’s modpack [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/raspberry-flavoured).
### JermsyBoy
  My resource pack was made to mirror JermsyBoy’s original texture pack as closely as possible. I thought he did great work but unfortunately has since stopped developing the project. Further, the textures had copyright protections on them, thus my pack was made to mimic it whilst still allowing everyone to modify and steal textures as they wish. 
  
  His original [texture pack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/a-little-taste-of-jerm).
  He also has a [youtube channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCICnSwa3x5sHTWmTP6YO30w), and has some stunning builds. 
### MiziraGamez
  Provided a framework for endless repairing (No XP cap). 
  
  You can find their datapack [here](https://modrinth.com/datapack/repair-cost-remover).
### Gooporeal
  Provided inspiration for the Lichen re-models I did. 
  
  Their [resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/gooporeals-lichen).
### Vectorwing
  Provided the inspiration for a lot of my textures. 
  
  Their [resource pack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/detail-brush).
### Rhythmic under PurpurMC 
  Provided a framework for looting shears. 
  
  Their [datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/purpurpacks-looting-shears?version=26.1&loader=datapack).


INSALLATION: The data and resource pack are bound together, place the same extracted file in the datapack and resourcepack locations and everything should be kosher.
